resources.string: If MediaSync doesn\'t work as expected, share this log with whoever helps you. It stays on this phone until you share it. It lists what MediaSync did and how this phone is set up, without photos, file names or places.
Measures how fast this phone can send to %1$s, with MediaSync open on it. Takes about 10 seconds.
%1$s couldn\'t be reached. Open MediaSync on it, on the same Wi-Fi, and try again.
When you send photos and videos yourself, each one folds into a paper airplane that flies away as fast as it\'s sent.
GitHub couldn\'t be reached. Try again later.
Checking asks GitHub which release is the latest. MediaSync sends nothing else, and never checks on its own.
How much of the log MediaSync keeps on this phone. When it\'s full, the oldest entries make room for new ones.
From 0.1 to 1024 MB. 1 MB unless you change it.
Type a size from 0.1 to 1024 MB, such as 0.5 or 20.
This phone forgets its role, paired phones, settings and history. Photos and videos stay.

Sends a file of the size you choose to %1$s, first in the next sync, to test the speed and the connection. %1$s only checks that it arrived exactly as sent, then deletes it: it never shows in the gallery and is never backed up.
A sending phone can send a test file to test the speed and the connection. This phone only checks that it arrived exactly as sent, then deletes it.
From 0.1 MB to 10 GB (10240 MB). 25 MB unless you change it.
Type a size from 0.1 to 10240 MB, such as 25 or 500.
A %1$s test file waits to be sent first in the next sync.
%1$s needs a newer version of MediaSync to take a test file. Update MediaSync there; until then, it waits.
%1$s doesn\'t have room for it now. It waits until there is.
%1$s couldn\'t write it. It\'s tried again in the next sync.
The receiving phone couldn\'t write it.
